name: source-explorer
description: Edit everything about an OBS source in one dock, and copy Streamer.bot / obs-websocket commands for it.
long_description: A dock that puts a source's transform, audio, filters and properties in one place, with right-click Command Copier menus that generate Streamer.bot C# and obs-websocket v5 commands for almost any field. Includes a source picker, popped-out filter windows, filter copy/paste and detachable tabs. Independent implementation inspired by the StreamUP Source Explorer. Built for OBS Studio 32.2.x on Windows 64-bit.
